reading.title: PAYMENT IN LIEU OF TAXES AND REGULATORY AGREEMENT Beacon Point Apartments · 2200 Beacon Avenue, Lantern Bay

candidates.quote: The Owner is building an 80-home rental project at 2200 Beacon Avenue (the "Project").
By Resolution No. 2025-41, adopted May 13, 2025, the City Council approved a payment in lieu of taxes for the Project, subject to this Agreement.
The Owner shall pay the City an annual payment in lieu of taxes equal to 25 percent of the property taxes that would otherwise be due, for a period of 15 years.
candidates.value: payment in lieu of taxes equal to 25 percent of property taxes for 15 years

candidates.quote: The Owner shall pay the City an annual payment in lieu of taxes equal to 25 percent of the property taxes that would otherwise be due, for a period of 15 years.
The Owner shall reserve 16 of the 80 homes in the Project as Affordable Homes.
Each Affordable Home shall be leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of Area Median Income.
candidates.value: at or below 60 percent of Area Median Income

candidates.quote: Monthly rent for each Affordable Home, including a utility allowance, shall not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year.
candidates.value: 60 percent rent limit based on HUD income limits published each year

candidates.quote: The requirements of this Article 3 shall remain in effect for 30 years from the date the first Affordable Home is leased.
candidates.value: 30 years from the date the first Affordable Home is leased

candidates.quote: The Owner is responsible for compliance with this Agreement, and this Agreement binds every later owner of the Project.
candidates.value: Owner and every later owner of the Project

candidates.quote: The Owner shall give the City 30 days' written notice before any sale of the Project.
candidates.value: 30 days' written notice before any sale

candidates.quote: The Owner shall deliver an annual compliance certificate to the City by March 1 of each year.
candidates.value: annual compliance certificate by March 1 of each year

candidates.quote: The certificate shall state counts only and shall not include household names or other personal information.
candidates.value: counts only without household names or personal information

candidates.quote: The City may inspect the Owner's leasing records for the Affordable Homes on 10 days' notice.
The City shall give the Owner written notice of any default under this Agreement.
If a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice, the Owner shall repay all abated taxes with interest.
candidates.value: repay all abated taxes with interest if default is not cured within 60 days

candidates.quote: The City may also seek any other remedy available at law or in equity.
candidates.value: any other remedy available at law or in equity
